name: Does a plumbing inspection include checking the sewer line?

mainEntity.name: Does a plumbing inspection include checking the sewer line?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard plumbing inspection typically does not include a full sewer line camera inspection unless specifically requested or if there are clear indications of a problem. A basic inspection will check for proper drainage at fixtures, which can suggest sewer line health. However, a dedicated sewer camera inspection involves inserting a camera into the main sewer line to thoroughly check for blockages, cracks, root intrusion, or collapses. This is a highly recommended add-on service if you are experiencing frequent backups or are purchasing an older home.
acceptedAnswer.description: A standard plumbing inspection checks fixture drainage, but a full sewer line camera inspection is a separate service, recommended for frequent backups or older homes.
